title: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Varanasi is a city in Uttar Pradesh with a population of 1,500,000. The spiritual capital of India, one of the world’s oldest living cities on the Ganges River, known for its ghats and temples. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
